newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks track other stock markets lower.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks track other stock markets lower.

text.p: Madrid stocks weakened in line with other European markets to close down on Wednesday, and traders said they expected to see further volatility in coming sessions.
The general index closed down 5.99 points, or 1.46 percent, at 405.27. The Ibex-35 index of leading shares ended 75.38, 1.59 percent, down at 4,677.80.
Traders said they expected to see a weak open on Thursday, although the tone would be largely predicted by movements in other major stock markets.
"In such a negative environment its impossible to do anything and its better to stay out," said one trader.
Traders said although the environment was particularly negative at the moment, in the medium term they expected stocks to remain firm.
Amongst individual stocks, Telefonica closed down 35 pesetas at 2,905 and Repsol ended down 100 pesetas at 4,540.
In the electricity sector, Endesa closed down 160 pesetas at 8,490, while Iberdrola was down 25 pesetas at 1,625.
